_strategyNote: Covers GET (query by filter) + POST (create). Same URL, different methods. Connection references tie botcomponents to connector OAuth flows.
lastVerifiedBy: Used by build-pipeline.stepComponents to resolve connections for connector-based components
knownQuirks: connectionreferencelogicalname must be globally unique per env — collisions require either finding the existing record via GET first or suffixing with a random token
connectorid format varies: some connectors use '/providers/Microsoft.PowerApps/apis/<name>' path, others use just the API name
Creating a connection reference does NOT create the underlying Connection — the Connection is provisioned when the user first authenticates
Until a Connection exists, attempts to use the reference return 400 with 'connection is not configured'
